summary: Texture-filename resolver. Reads the input path string from *(this+0) (fallback byte_5EA438), extracts the filename after the last '\' (0x5C), copies it to this+992, truncates at the last '.' (0x2E), appends ".tga", then calls TGATextureFileScanner on a zeroed local to enumerate matching texture files. Stores the scanner result at this+0x420 and returns that same value. The scanner's linked-list output is walked and freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf (node at +4, data at +0, ownership flag at +8).

Scan backwards from the end of this+992 for the last '.' (0x2E) and truncate there (*v7 = 0), bounded so it never walks before the buffer start.

Store the scanner result: *((_DWORD*)this + 264) = v17 (this+0x420); this value is also the function return.
